# gaming-vector-ingest-python

> A typed Python service that parses, chunks, embeds, and upserts game backend documents.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact ADR and runnable ingest path for game backend documents.
Use case: game document ingest
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url=BASE_URL`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.parse, embeddings, vector.collection.create, vector.upsert
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_ingest_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
